content:
Class 5 mensuration adds triangles and VOLUME to perimeter and area — with composite shapes and cost problems. One of the most diagram-friendly Olympiad chapters. Here is what it tests, the formulas, and a free 10-question test with figures.

What the Class 5 Maths Olympiad Perimeter, Area and Volume chapter tests

  • Perimeter of rectangles, squares and regular polygons
  • Area of rectangles, squares and triangles (½ × base × height)
  • Volume of cubes and cuboids
  • Composite shapes, unit choices and cost problems

Key facts your child should know

  • P(rect) = 2(l + b); regular polygon P = sides × length.
  • A(triangle) = ½ × base × height.
  • V(cuboid) = l × b × h; V(cube) = side³.
  • 1 litre = 1000 cu cm connects capacity and volume.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Forgetting the ½ in the triangle area formula.
  • Writing volume in sq units instead of cu units.
  • Using perimeter where the problem needs area (or volume).

questions.q: A four-sided plot has sides 26 m, 19 m, 33 m and 22 m. What is the length of its boundary?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = sum of all the sides = 26 + 19 + 33 + 22 = 100 m.

questions.q: A rectangular sports ground measures 83 m by 46 m. Find the distance around it.
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 × (length + breadth) = 2 × (83 + 46) = 2 × 129 = 258 m.

questions.q: A square courtyard has a side of 43 m. Find the area of the courtyard.
questions.explanation: Area of a square = side × side = 43 × 43 = 1849 sq. m.

questions.q: A cubical gift box has each edge 9 cm long. Find its volume.
questions.explanation: Volume of a cube = edge × edge × edge = 9 × 9 × 9 = 729 cu. cm.

questions.q: An aquarium of size 80 cm by 25 cm by 20 cm is filled to the brim. How many litres of water are in it? (1 litre = 1000 cu. cm)
questions.explanation: Volume = 80 × 25 × 20 = 40000 cu. cm. Since 1000 cu. cm = 1 litre, the tank holds 40000 ÷ 1000 = 40 litres.

questions.q: A road-safety sign is an equilateral triangle with each side 27 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has 3 equal sides, so perimeter = 3 × 27 = 81 cm.

questions.q: A square window pane has an area of 400 sq. cm. Find the perimeter of the pane.
questions.explanation: Since 20 × 20 = 400, the side is 20 cm. Perimeter = 4 × 20 = 80 cm.

faq.q: What is the area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 8 cm?
How many litres fill a 100 × 60 × 50 cm tank?
faq.a: Volume = 300,000 cu cm; at 1000 cu cm per litre that is 300 litres.
